name: Noir Mystery: Item Product Shot
description: Image preset for a item product shot in the Noir Mystery look.
system_prompt: Write one image prompt for a prop or item shot. Describe material, wear, size cue, and the one detail that makes it recognisable from the entity, then apply the style.
context_prompt: single item centred on a plain surface, three-quarter angle, whole object visible with its key detail facing the viewer, film noir still, hard chiaroscuro, venetian-blind shadows across the face, rain-slick streets, fedoras and trench coats, cigarette smoke, black and white or heavily desaturated, single hard key light, deep blacks, wet reflective surfaces
negative_prompt: bright saturated colour, sunny daylight, modern technology, cartoon, cheerful mood, text, watermark
